annotations.annotation_text: Divisional threshold preceding Book III (The Four Watches of Shaun, pages 403–590). Aligned with Giambattista Vico's third historical age—the Human or Democratic Age—in which heroic aristocracy yields to popular assemblies, rationalism, legal institutions, and bureaucratic oratory.
sources: Vico, Giambattista. The New Science (trans. Bergin and Fisch). Cornell University Press, 1948.
Campbell, Joseph, and Henry Morton Robinson. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. Harcourt, Brace, 1944.
